body:
This adds the bounded source-application and canonical-publication operators needed for the ten-worker unmatched-ingredient campaign. The existing writers are tied to earlier named batches; these operators accept an explicit, independently reviewed campaign plan and refuse incomplete or stale evidence before writing.

Depends on #1158 at `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`; the PR base is that dependency branch. This PR contains implementation, regression tests and immutable review evidence. Campaign owner edits and regenerated release products will follow in a separate dependent PR after scientific reconciliation. No maintained ingredient, canonical mapping, unified snapshot, workflow, threshold or pin changes are included.

- Source application binds all frozen cases, exact proposal/acceptance/published-head evidence, native producer bytes, complete before/after inventories and genuine unmapped preimages for promotions. It uses guarded writers and reserves receipts before mutation.
- Canonical publication binds the exact native generation triple, closed policy history, whole projected alias checks and native approval-free receipt lineage. Historical owner attribution remains historical; a changed owner receives no inherited scientific approval.
- Both operators fail closed on stale bytes, path aliases, missing/extra owners, disconnected receipt chains, late inventory changes and incomplete publication.

Resolves #1174, #1194, #1195, #1197, #1198 and #1200. The five adversarial findings were fixed and independently re-reviewed. The bounded archive at `reports/unmatched_campaign_operators_1174_20261108/independent-review/` retains original findings, failed probes, fixes and final reviews. `SELECTION.json` maps319 original paths to240 unique hash-preserved evidence files. Original TSV empty terminal fields and historical diff whitespace are intentionally preserved for exact hashes; no formatting has altered archived evidence.

Validation so far:88 source-operator tests and106 publication tests pass, with Ruff/Black/Mypy checks passing. Independent review reproduced the five findings, reran11 focused controls and independently reconstructed the3,007-row native diagnostic plus exact sidecar offline. Its combined review SHA256 is `3348c645fa9c2fea7428702c5783a8dd8de16552cb2034a4a36cd22846f593db`. Full `just qc`, the full suite, CI and final committed-head review are pending; this remains a draft until those finish. The first local QC attempt passed schema validation but lacked the pinned validator's GitPython dependency in the new dedicated environment; environment repair and a fresh run are recorded separately.

This review approves the operator contracts only. It grants no case, owner, role or supported-export approval; complete scientific intake and cross-shard reconciliation remain prerequisites for applying campaign data.
title: Add guarded campaign curation and canonical publication operators
